contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Pod/ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5
contributing_factors.reasoning: This ad-serving pod is an independent failing backend in the frontend request path: errors on the ad service's flag-evaluation calls surface as failed GetAds/API-data work upstream, so the frontend errors are downstream symptoms rather than another root resource. The pod also runs near its CPU limit during the incident, consistent with an overloaded backend.
contributing_factors.evidence: The ad service had firing NoRequestsDetected alerts at 17:56–17:58 and a firing RequestErrorRate alert at 18:08 (0.00991). Service metrics record STATUS_CODE_ERROR on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean (value 69 on a second instance during 17:57–17:59; the earlier instance reached 112); frontend metrics record the corresponding GetAds/API-data error path (value 747 by 17:59). This pod started at 17:48:48, and its CPU metric reached 0.048996 cores against a 0.05-core limit at 17:55:46 (about 98%).

contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Pod/payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn
contributing_factors.reasoning: Payment is a second, independent failing backend: checkout's PlaceOrder failures traverse PaymentService/Charge, so the checkout and higher-level request errors are downstream of this payment path and are not explained by the ad or fraud-detection faults.
contributing_factors.evidence: RequestErrorRate for payment was firing at 17:53 with value 0.03964. The checkout service metrics show STATUS_CODE_ERROR for both PaymentService/Charge and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, reaching 78 at 17:51:32 and remaining at that value through 17:59:32. This payment pod was the active replacement pod during that interval (started 17:48:49).

contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Pod/fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv
contributing_factors.reasoning: This is a separate memory-exhaustion failure in the fraud-detection workload. The container was OOM-killed and restarted, interrupting its own processing; it is not a downstream symptom of the ad or payment request paths.
contributing_factors.evidence: The pod status records lastState.reason=OOMKilled, exit code 137, finished at 17:50:32, and restartCount=1. Its memory working set reached 414,052,352 bytes (about 98.7% of its limit) at 17:49:25. Alerts subsequently reported NoRequestsDetected for fraud-detection at 17:56–17:58 and RequestErrorRate at 18:07 (0.00991).
